extrapolationRefused: The harness throughput is a fact about a 1.07M-parameter random model, not a prediction about a 0.5B one. Reporting it as the campaign's feasibility would be exactly the parameter-count estimate the brief forbids, run backwards.

harnessSelfTest.note: Throughput is measured per run and is not part of the certification body: a wall-clock number would make the hash depend on how busy the machine was.
